formatMultipliers.note: Likes relative to each author median, pooled over Marcel (30 d), @kargulstudio, rico (60 d), Augustas (current era) and the co-founders (n: single-landscape 392, portrait pair 36, 2-up landscape 32, thirds 9, 4-up mixed 32, 4-up same size 23, video 56). The six schema keys are rounded planning values: carousel-2 assumes a 4:5-7:8 pair (landscape pairs 0.79); carousel-4 assumes same-size images (1.12 when the four crops differ); video-loop is a cold lead (as a quote of a still that worked, Marcel 1.51x the still, n=10, hence video-followup-quote 1.5); text is a planning penalty for 10k and 4-follower accounts (rico text 0.19, Augustas quote-text 0.19-0.30; Marcel text 1.07 on 60k followers). Cross-check with the 29-account study: 2-up 1.20, 4-up 1.19, video 1.03, 3-up 1.00, single 0.76 (knowledge/web/x-design-posts.md 6.1).

subjectMultipliers.note: Augustas era 1 (n: dashboard 20, sidebar 11, hero 39, footer 9, bento/card 29, pricing 5); crm-table and calendar from Marcel (n=4, 2); branding 0.60 Marcel (n=15), 0.80 rico; spec 2.72 rico (n=6), 6.93 Marcel (n=4). Use to choose the lead subject, not as exact forecasts.

rico's 16:00 slot, first posts 15-18 1.22x (n=26), later 15-18 1.20x likes / 1.93x views (n=7); @kargulstudio posts 14:00-17:00.

US East afternoon; Marcel's late posts drew 2.0x views (00-03, n=11). Optional fifth post, never a third media post for one account.

dailyPosts.why: Augustas era 1 (n=321): 1st post of a day 1.12x, 2nd 0.71x, 3rd 0.45x, 4th 0.12x; days with 2 posts 1.27x, with 3 posts 0.55x. Co-founder accounts (4 followers) get 10-26 median views, so a second daily post adds little. X decays each further post by one author in a viewer's feed (XP-26). Big accounts flatten this (Marcel 6.2/day at 60k).

defaultDay.content: lead: product UI (dashboard, crm, calendar, inbox, sidebar) or the series step due today
second: another cut or a second project; or a motion quote of yesterday's best still
a different cut of a series in his detail voice (pair, hero variant, section)
a different cut in his decision voice (close-up, thirds, bento, section)
a section or hero in his contrast voice

dailyPosts.rotation: Swap the 16:00 and 19:30 co-founders daily; when Marius is inactive, the 22:00 slot stays empty (3-4 posts a day).

series.why: Measured gaps: close-up/full within 0.1-1 d (rico fullview -> closer view 8 h later 1.12x; Augustas thirds -> hero 0.95 d); full -> thirds 2.8-4.2 h (Marcel, 1.64x and 1.11x); still -> motion quote median 0.61 d (Marcel n=10, 1.51x the still) and 1.52 d (Augustas, 7.7x his median); motion quotes 7-15 d later 0.14-0.30x of the still, so later motion goes standalone. Image reuse (rico n=129): <=3 d 0.49x, 4-14 d 1.15x, 15-30 d 0.88x, 31-60 d 1.06x, >60 d 0.53x; 3rd showing 0.61x. Own-quote share 49-51% of originals (Marcel, rico). Project series: Marcel 5 posts / 17 d, rico Alpaca 14 / 132 d (median gap 6 d).
series.note: closeupToFullDays follows the founder plan (close-up day 1, full day 2); the data allows the same day if the two posts are on one account >= 6 h apart. sameFormatMaxPerDay is network-wide.

replies.why: Augustas era 1: link in post 0.33x likes / 0.53x views (n=14) vs link in a self-reply 1.02x / 1.07x (n=223); rico replies with a link a median 155 min later on 117 of 117 posts; Marcel link-in-reply 1.31x vs link-in-post 0.97x.

captions.why: Augustas: 7-10 words 1.16x (n=79), 1-3 words 0.72x (n=65), UI noun 1.22x vs 0.85x, questions 0.69x now, @mentions 0.53x.

never: a third media post on one account in one day
two posts from one account less than 6 h apart
the same image on any founder account within 7 days, or more than 3 showings
the same caption, or a shared three-word run, on two accounts the same day
a question, poll or "which one" caption
an external link or @mention in the main post
a fictional brand name in the caption, or work from a fiction presented as a client
money, client or outcome claims on concept work
bento, pricing or branding as the 08:00 lead

dataThin.coFounders: faulkner_Design, rokasrem, marius_vanagas have 4 followers; their hours and formats carry no performance signal. Defaults come from @augustasdesign and the benchmarks; re-rank after 20 posts per cell (XS-26).
dataThin.hours: Hour effects are confounded with first-post-of-day; test the lead at 14:30 on two days a week for three weeks before moving it.
dataThin.thirds: Vertical thirds n=9 pooled (1 Augustas post at 17.6x); strong direction, small n.
